task: LiDAR Scene Flow and Dynamic Segmentation Evaluation

breakdown.valid_filter: Only evaluate points where is_valid == true.

metrics.EPE: Per-point end-point error: the L2 norm of (predicted_flow - ground_truth_flow). Report the mean over all valid points in each subset.
metrics.Accuracy Strict: Per-point binary inlier test: a point is an inlier (value 1.0) if the absolute L2 flow error is below 0.05 OR the ratio of L2 flow error to ground truth flow magnitude is below 0.05; otherwise 0.0. Report the mean (fraction of inliers) over all valid points in each subset.
metrics.Accuracy Relaxed: Same definition as Accuracy Strict but with threshold 0.10 instead of 0.05.
metrics.Angle Error: Per-point angular discrepancy in space-time. Augment each 3D flow vector (fx, fy, fz) to 4D by appending sweep_pair_time_delta_s as the fourth component, yielding (fx, fy, fz, dt). Normalize both the predicted and ground truth augmented vectors to unit length. The angle error is arccos(clamp(dot_product, -1, 1)), in radians. Report the mean over all valid points in each subset.

segmentation.Dynamic IoU: Global intersection-over-union for the dynamic/static point classification. Computed as TP / (TP + FP + FN) across ALL valid points in the entire dataset, where: TP = predicted_dynamic AND gt_dynamic, FP = predicted_dynamic AND gt_static, FN = predicted_static AND gt_dynamic.

summary_metrics.EPE 3-Way Average: The arithmetic mean of three EPE values computed over: (1) all Foreground/Dynamic valid points, (2) all Foreground/Static valid points, (3) all Background/Static valid points. Each value is the global mean EPE over that class/motion group across all sweeps and both distance categories.

format.per_subset: Object keyed by 'Class/Motion/Distance' strings (e.g. 'Foreground/Dynamic/Close'). Each value is an object with keys: EPE, Accuracy Strict, Accuracy Relaxed, Angle Error — all floats.
format.per_class_motion: Object keyed by 'Class/Motion' strings (e.g. 'Foreground/Dynamic'). Each value has the same four metric keys, computed over both distance categories combined.
format.summary: Object with keys: 'Dynamic IoU' (float) and 'EPE 3-Way Average' (float).

output.precision: Round all float values to 6 decimal places.
output.notes: Excluded class/motion combinations must not appear in the output.

data.layout: Each directory contains subdirectories named by log_id, each containing .feather files named by timestamp_ns.

annotation_columns.flow_tx_m: float32 — ground truth flow X component (meters)
annotation_columns.flow_ty_m: float32 — ground truth flow Y component (meters)
annotation_columns.flow_tz_m: float32 — ground truth flow Z component (meters)
annotation_columns.category_indices: uint8 — point category index (0 = background, 1–4 = foreground classes)
annotation_columns.is_dynamic: bool — whether the point belongs to a dynamic object
annotation_columns.is_close: bool — whether the point is within a spatial proximity box around the sensor
annotation_columns.is_valid: bool — whether the flow annotation is valid for evaluation
